clips.title: The story
paras: Kil'hala is a jungle troll tailoring trainer stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Skilled in working with both everyday cloth and exotic woven materials, he instructs Horde crafters looking to refine their needlework. Beyond common thread, he weaves nether-lace robes for young Horde mages who bring him locks of hair from the laughing sisters of Ashenvale.

Positioned at the bustling hub of the Crossroads, Kil'hala offers his tailoring expertise to passing travelers and Horde recruits. While much of his craft involves common spun bolts and garments fit for dry plains life, his knowledge extends into rare magical textiles. As a favor to the mage Deino, he fashions nether-lace robes for young mages who bring him hair taken from the laughing sisters, dryads of Ashenvale's forests.
